newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo prosecutors raid offices of M'bishi Oil--NHK.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo prosecutors raid offices of M'bishi Oil--NHK.

text.p: Tokyo prosecutors raided the offices of Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd on Thursday as part of their investigation into allegations of tax evasion against an oil dealer with whom Mitsubishi has done business, NHK public television reported.
A Mitsubishi Oil spokesman said officials from the prosecutor's office appeared to have visited the firm. He said, however, that he could not provide any other details.
The Tokyo District Public Prosecutors Office declined comment.
NHK said prosecutors were investigating Mitsubishi Oil as part of their probe into tax evasion allegations against an Osaka-based petroleum dealer.
Last week, Mitsubishi Oil denied reports it had conducted unusual oil trading with the petroleum dealer, saying its dealings were normal business transactions.
NHK also reported on Thursday that Tokyo prosecutors had arrested Junichi Izui, the president of the Osaka-based oil wholesale company.
Sources close to the Osaka Taxation Bureau said last week that the oil dealer is suspected of evading 320 million yen in taxes by not reporting income totalling 660 million yen from 1992 to 1994.

Last month, court papers in a legal dispute between Mitsubishi Oil and Mitsui Mining Co Ltd said that Mitsubishi had allegedly given 2.4 billion yen to Izui through oil deals made between Mitsubishi and Mitsui from 1993 to 1995.
